facts.statement: Suzhousaurus was an unusually large therizinosauroid reaching lengths of 6 meters and weighing nearly 3.1 tonnes.
facts.quote: Suzhousaurus was an unusually large Early Cretaceous therizinosauroid reaching lengths of 6 m and nearly 3.1 t in weight.

facts.statement: Unlike advanced therizinosaurids, the vertebral column of Suzhousaurus was not highly pneumatized.
facts.quote: Unlike derived (advanced) therizinosaurids, the vertebral column was not highly pneumatized.

facts.statement: Suzhousaurus is known from two specimens found in the Xiagou and Zhonggou Formations of the Xinminbao Group during fieldwork in 1999 and 2004.
facts.quote: The genus is known from two specimens discovered in the Xiagou and Zhonggou Formations, both part of the Xinminbao Group. These findings were made during fieldwork in 1999 and 2004.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Suzhousaurus was discovered in the Xinminbao Group at the Yujingzi Basin.
facts.quote: The holotype specimen, FRDC-GSJB-99, was discovered in the Xinminbao Group at the Yujingzi Basin.

facts.statement: Suzhousaurus was described in 2007 by Li Daqing, Peng Cuo, You Hailu, Matthew Lamanna, Jerrald Harris, Kenneth Lacovara, and Zhang Jianping, with the type species named Suzhousaurus megatherioides.
facts.quote: The specimen was described in 2007 by Li Daqing, Peng Cuo, You Hailu, Matthew Lamanna, Jerrald Harris, Kenneth Lacovara and Zhang Jianping, also naming the type species Suzhousaurus megatherioides.

facts.statement: Specimens of Suzhousaurus date to the early–mid-Aptian stage from the Xiagou Formation and the Early Albian from the Zhonggou Formation.
facts.quote: FRDC-GSJB-99 was discovered around 1999 being found in mid gray-variegated beds of the Xiagou Formation dating to the early–mid-Aptian stage, and FRDC-GSJB-2004-001 was found in 2004 at the upper red beds in the Zhonggou Formation dating to the Early Albian.

facts.statement: Evidence from related therizinosauroids suggests that Suzhousaurus had at least partial feathering.
facts.quote: Feather impressions from the therizinosauroids Beipiaosaurus suggest at least a partial feathering in Suzhousaurus.

facts.statement: The right humerus of Suzhousaurus measures 55 cm in length and lacks several traits found in other therizinosaurids, such as a prominent posterior trochanter.
facts.quote: The right humerus is a large element, measuring 55 cm long, however, it lacks several therizinosaurid traits; the deltopectoral crest is more reduced than in most therizinosaurids such as Erliansaurus, Erlikosaurus, Neimongosaurus, Segnosaurus and Therizinosaurus, and the posterior trochanter is not present on the posterior surface of the humeral shaft center, which is present in therizinosaurids.

facts.statement: The femur of Suzhousaurus is highly thickened and robust, measuring a total length of 84 cm.
facts.quote: The femur is highly thickened and robust with a well-developed great trochanter and articular surfaces. It has a total length of 84 cm.

facts.statement: Suzhousaurus was a relatively large herbivore within its ecosystem.
facts.quote: Suzhousaurus was a relatively large herbivorous component of its ecosystems.

facts.statement: During the late Aptian to early Albian, a large lake surrounded by narrow hills likely existed in the Mazongshan and Jiuquan areas, facilitating movement for dinosaur faunas.
facts.quote: During the late Aptian–early Albian eras, a large lake surrounded by narrow hills was likely present in the Mazongshan and Jiuquan areas, allowing dinosaur faunas to travel across areas without geographical barriers.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Suzhousaurus is synonymous with the earlier described therizinosauroid Nanshiungosaurus bohlini.
facts.quote: Though Suzhousaurus is known from these two specimens, an earlier named and described therizinosauroid from the adjacent basin, "Nanshiungosaurus" bohlini, may be synonymous with the former.

facts.statement: Li and colleagues originally assigned Suzhousaurus to the Therizinosauroidea in a basal position.
facts.quote: Li and coauthors, in their description, assigned Suzhousaurus to the Therizinosauroidea, in a basal position.

facts.statement: A 2019 phylogenetic analysis by Hartman and colleagues classified Suzhousaurus as a therizinosaurid taxon, though with poor statistical support.
facts.quote: In 2019, Hartman and team performed a phylogenetic analysis for the Therizinosauria using data provided by Zanno 2010 and found this time Suzhousaurus as a therizinosaurid taxon, however, with poor support.

facts.statement: Suzhousaurus lived approximately 115 million years ago during the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del periodo Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 115 millones de años durante el Aptiense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Fieldwork uncovering these specimens took place in 1999 and 2004.
facts.quote: Estos hallazgos se realizaron durante los trabajos de campo en 1999 y 2004.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Suzhousaurus is a synonym of the previously named therizinosauroid Nanshiungosaurus bohlini from an adjacent basin.
facts.quote: Aunque Suzhousaurus se conoce a partir de estos dos especímenes, un terizinosauroide anteriormente nombrado y descrito de la cuenca adyacente, "Nanshiungosaurus" bohlini, puede ser sinónimo del primero.

facts.statement: Suzhousaurus was an unusually large Early Cretaceous therizinosauroid reaching a length of 6 meters and a weight of nearly 3.1 tonnes.
facts.quote: Suzhousaurus era un terizinosauroide del Cretácico Inferior inusualmente grande que alcanzaba una longitud de 6 metros y casi 3,1 toneladas de peso.

facts.statement: Unlike derived therizinosaurids, the vertebrae were not highly pneumatized, but the pelvis showed a marked opistopubic structure similar to therizinosaurids.
facts.quote: A diferencia de los terizinosáuridos derivados, la columna vertebral no estaba muy neumatizada, sin embargo, la pelvis muestra una marcada estructura opistopúbica similar a la de los terizinosáuridos.

facts.statement: Like other therizinosauroids, Suzhousaurus had elongated claws and neck for feeding, robust hind legs, and a large body ending in a reduced tail.
facts.quote: Al igual que otros terizinosauroides, Suzhousaurus tenía garras y cuello alargados para comer, patas traseras robustas y un tronco grande que terminaba en una cola reducida.

facts.statement: Suzhousaurus is distinguished from all other therizinosauroid taxa by a rounded upper edge of the preacetabular iliac projection, an obturator foramen wider than it is tall, a relatively short pubis with a deep and wide obturator notch, and a posteriorly deflected ischial shaft.
facts.quote: Suzhousaurus se puede diferenciar de todos los demás taxones de terizinosauroides por tener un borde superior redondeado de proyección preacetabular del ilion, un agujero en el área del obturador con un ancho total mayor que su altura desde la parte superior a la inferior, un pubis relativamente corto con una muesca obturatriz profunda y ancha y el eje isquiádico está desviado hacia atrás.

facts.statement: Feather impressions from the therizinosauroid Beipiaosaurus suggest at least partial feathering in Suzhousaurus.
facts.quote: Las impresiones de plumas del terizinosauroide Beipiaosaurus sugieren al menos un emplumado parcial en Suzhousaurus.

facts.statement: The right humerus is large at 550 mm long but lacks several therizinosaurid traits, having a reduced deltopectoral crest compared to most therizinosaurids and lacking a posterior trochanter on the humeral shaft.
facts.quote: El húmero derecho es un elemento grande, mide 550 milímetros de largo, sin embargo, carece de varios rasgos de terizinosáuridos, la cresta deltopectoral es más reducida que en la mayoría de los terizinosáuridos como Erliansaurus, Erlikosaurus, Neimongosaurus, Segnosaurus y Therizinosaurus, y el trocánter posterior no está presente en la superficie posterior del centro del eje humeral, que está presente en los terizinosáuridos.

facts.statement: The femur was very thick and robust with a large trochanter and well-developed articular surfaces, measuring a total length of 840 mm.
facts.quote: El fémur es muy engrosado y robusto, con un gran trocánter y superficies articulares bien desarrollados. Tiene una longitud total de 840 milímetros.

facts.statement: The genus was named by Li et al. in 2007.

facts.statement: The species S. megatherioides was named by Li et al. in 2007.
facts.quote: binomial_authority: Li et al., 2007

facts.statement: However, the genus is often recovered as the sister taxon to the Therizinosauridae family.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, el género a menudo se recupera como el taxón hermano de esta familia.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen FRDC-GSJB-99 was discovered in the Xinminbao Group within the Yujingzi Basin.
facts.quote: El espécimen holotipo , FRDC-GSJB-99, fue descubierto en el Grupo Xinminbao en la Cuenca Yujingzi.

facts.statement: The species was formally described in 2007 by a team led by Li Daqing and colleagues.
facts.quote: El espécimen fue descrito en 2007 por Li Daqing, Peng Cuo, You Hailu, Matthew Lamanna, Jerrald Harris, Kenneth Lacovara y Zhang Jianping

facts.statement: The generic name Suzhousaurus is derived from Suzhou, the ancient name for the Jiuquan area.
facts.quote: El nombre genérico, Suzhousaurus , se deriva de Suzhou, que es el antiguo nombre del área de Jiuquan .

facts.statement: The specific name megatherioides indicates a resemblance to the giant ground sloths of the genus Megatherium.
facts.quote: El nombre específico, S. megatherioides, indica un parecido con los perezosos terrestres gigantes Megatherium.

facts.statement: A significantly more complete skeleton was described in 2008.

facts.statement: The second specimen was found in the upper red beds of the Zhonggou Formation dating to the early Albian.
facts.quote: FRDC-GSJB-2004-001 se encontró en 2004 en los lechos rojos superiores de la Formación Zhonggou que datan del Albiano temprano.

facts.statement: Suzhousaurus lived between 121.4 and 110.1 million years ago during the Aptian to Albian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Albian (121.4 to 110.1 million years ago)

facts.statement: In its original description, the genus was assigned to Therizinosauroidea in a basal position.
facts.quote: Li y colegas, en su descripción del género, asignaron a Suzhousaurus entre los Therizinosauroidea, en una posición basal.

facts.statement: A 2010 review by Lindsay Zanno placed Suzhousaurus in a more derived position as the sister taxon to Therizinosauridae.
facts.quote: En la gran revisión de Therizinosauria realizada por Lindsay Zanno en 2010, encontró a Suzhousaurus en una posición más derivada como el taxón hermano de Therizinosauridae

facts.statement: A 2019 phylogenetic analysis by Hartman et al. found Suzhousaurus within Therizinosauridae, but with little statistical support.
facts.quote: En 2019 , Hartman y su equipo realizaron un análisis filogenético para Therizinosauria utilizando datos proporcionados por Zanno 2010 y encontraron esta vez a Suzhousaurus como un taxón de los terizinosáuridos, sin embargo, con poco apoyo.

facts.statement: The parent group for Suzhousaurus is the family Therizinosauridae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Therizinosauridae

facts.statement: Suzhousaurus is classified within the family Therizinosauridae.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a partial skeleton lacking skull material but including a right humerus, right scapulocoracoid, ten dorsal vertebrae, partial ribs, an almost complete left pubis, a fragmentary right pubis, the lower end of the left ilium, and various unidentified elements.
facts.quote: Consiste en un esqueleto parcial que carece de material craneal pero contiene un húmero derecho, escapulocoracoideo derecho , 10 vértebras dorsales , costillas parciales , pubis izquierdo casi completo y derecho fragmentario , el extremo inferior del ilion izquierdo y varios elementos no identificados.

facts.statement: The second specimen contains the last three dorsal vertebrae, a sacrum of five vertebrae, the first six caudal vertebrae, a very complete pelvic girdle, and both femurs, with the right femur being fragmentary.
facts.quote: El ejemplar FRDC-GSJB-2004-001 que contiene las tres últimas vértebras dorsales, el sacro compuesto por cinco vértebras sacras , las seis primeras vértebras caudales , una cintura pélvica muy completa compuesta por el ilion izquierdo , pubis e isquion , y ambos fémures, fémur derecho está fragmentado

facts.statement: Suzhousaurus was a relatively large herbivorous component of its ecosystems.
facts.quote: Suzhousaurus era un componente herbívoro relativamente grande de sus ecosistemas.

facts.quote: Li y sus colegas señalaron que Suzhousaurus podría ser idéntico a "Nanshiungosaurus" bohlini, un terizinosauroide anterior encontrado en el mismo grupo geológico y también conocido a partir de restos limitados.
